authorization: Owner instruction, 27 September 2026: run the GSE190821 epithelial arm to bound rival 2

supersedes.why: a three-lens adversarial review before any value was read returned three fatal findings per lens on the endpoint's construct validity, the absence of a perturbation-engagement check, and a decision rule with no interval; every factual claim was independently verified against the tracked files before it was accepted

scope.rival_2_as_restated_here: the epithelial integrin's effect on the fibroblast may be indirect, mediated by a change in the epithelium rather than by TGF-beta activated at the epithelial surface acting on the fibroblast
scope.why_restated: RATIONALE.md grounded rival 2 in Morris 2003 and Koth 2007 as non-TGF-beta routes, but both papers attribute their phenotypes to loss of TGF-beta activation in their own titles. A metalloproteinase and surfactant panel would therefore measure TGF-beta-mediated consequences of removing the integrin and would not separate rival 2 from the mechanism A15 proposes. The separable question is whether the epithelium changes at all.
scope.is_not: a test of A15. This deposit fails A15 stage 1 gate conditions 1, 3, 4 and 5: no recorded validation that the perturbation took effect, no activated-TGF-beta readout, no separated fibroblast compartment, and no ligand arm.
scope.condition_1_consequence: because condition 1 fails, no bound may be claimed from a null unless the pre-declared engagement control below separates in its declared direction
scope.may_never_be_reported_as: evidence for or against the A15 hypothesis

stage1.unchanged_by_this_revision: the arms, the batch and sex matching, the join and its independent agreement with A1's records, the naming hazards, the depth audit, the exact power floors and the precedent finding

design_facts_the_deposit_states.genotype: RiboTag crossed to ShhCre, both on C57BL/6; HA-tagged Rpl22 expressed in the epithelium. Stated at cohort level, not per mouse.
design_facts_the_deposit_states.harvest: day 7 after bleomycin exposure, flash-frozen, homogenised later under native conditions with cycloheximide
design_facts_the_deposit_states.paired_input: an aliquot of each mouse's homogenate was taken as the input and is the library the deposit labels Whole Lung; the remainder was anti-HA immunoprecipitated and is the library labelled Epithelium
design_facts_the_deposit_states.correction: the v1 freeze and the stage 1b addendum wrongly listed genotype, antibody dose and schedule as not stated, and wrongly declared immunoprecipitation purity unverifiable. See reports/RIVAL2_STAGE1_ERRATUM.md.

design_facts_the_deposit_does_not_state: harvest time of day, warm ischaemia time, or homogenisation order for any of the 11 mice
immunoprecipitation yield, input RNA mass or RNA integrity number, so efficiency remains unknown even though purity is computable
per-mouse genotype confirmation, cage, litter, weight, or measured target engagement
how mice were allocated to antibody, so randomisation is not established

source_paper.citation: Auyeung VC et al., Am J Physiol Lung Cell Mol Physiol 2022
source_paper.consequence: agreement is reproduction and is reported as reproduction, never as a finding of this repository
source_paper.prior_exposure_recorded: this session read the abstract, which states that the IRE1alpha inhibitor lowers integrin alphaVbeta6 expression with correspondingly lower TGF-beta-induced epithelial gene expression
source_paper.order_required: freeze, then compute, then compare against the paper

eligibility.paired_compartment: Whole Lung, the input aliquot from the same homogenate

excluded.Vehicle: the KIRA8 vehicle, not the antibody control

measurability_rule_declared_before_any_v.member_retained_if: median raw count at least 10 across all libraries used by that score, pooled, with no reference to arm labels
measurability_rule_declared_before_any_v.why_label_free: a filter that used arm membership would not be invariant under permutation, and the exact permutation and rank-sum tests declared below would no longer be exact. The pooled median is label-free, so every declared test stays exact.
measurability_rule_declared_before_any_v.composite_refused_if: fewer than 0.80 of mapped members are measurable; the refusal is then the result for that composite
measurability_rule_declared_before_any_v.why: presence in a 42,548-row annotation index is presence in the annotation, not detection above background in the library
measurability_rule_declared_before_any_v.reported_next_to: every coverage figure, so an annotation-mapping count is never read as a measurability count

permutation_exactness_note.standardisation_is_label_free: per-gene standardisation for the composites and for the omnibus profiles uses the pooled mice without reference to arm labels, so it is invariant under permutation and the tests remain exact
permutation_exactness_note.omnibus_p_floor: each split and its complement give the same between-minus-within statistic, so the smallest attainable one-sided omnibus p is 2/70 = 0.028571, which is the threshold declared in the reading

primary_1_epithelial_identity_and_state.why: this is the construct rival 2 names, an epithelial state change, and it is the only frozen panel in this repository defined for this deposit and compartment

declared_here_not_inherited.status: reported separately, no decision attached, not part of either composite

primary_2_omnibus_epithelial_divergence.why: rival 2 as restated asks whether the epithelium changes at all, which is an omnibus question and needs no curated gene list, so it cannot be defeated by a curated set's construct validity
primary_2_omnibus_epithelial_divergence.genes: every measurable gene in the epithelial libraries of the eight primary mice, with Itgb6 excluded
primary_2_omnibus_epithelial_divergence.gene_filter: raw count at least 10 in at least 4 of the 8 primary epithelial libraries, reusing A1's declared min_count of 10 for this deposit
primary_2_omnibus_epithelial_divergence.distance: one minus the Pearson correlation between per-mouse profiles of log2 CPM, standardised per gene across the eight mice
primary_2_omnibus_epithelial_divergence.statistic: mean between-arm distance minus mean within-arm distance
primary_2_omnibus_epithelial_divergence.test: exact permutation over all 70 assignments of eight mice into two arms of four
primary_2_omnibus_epithelial_divergence.also_reported: the same statistic on Euclidean distance, as a sensitivity

a5a11_injury_residual.status: descriptive, carries no decision weight, may not be cited in support of the verdict
a5a11_injury_residual.shared_provenance: both trace to Strunz 2020; A0's discovery set is GSE141259 and this module is ADI_published_400 from doi 10.1038/s41467-020-17358-3
a5a11_injury_residual.corroboration_claim_withdrawn: agreement between these two overlapping sets from one source study, scored on the same eight mice, is close to guaranteed and is not corroboration

a0_set_demoted.new_role: a named handling and stress covariate, not an endpoint
a0_set_demoted.why: its membership is dominated by chaperone and proteostasis genes and immediate-early stress genes, it contains no canonical alveolar identity or transitional marker, and its overlap with A1's frozen epithelial panel for this deposit is exactly zero. A0's own discovery configuration excludes SFTPC, SFTPA1, SFTPA2, SFTPB, SFTPD, ABCA3, NAPSA, AGER, KRT8, KRT19, CLDN4 and CDKN1A from its universe by name, so it cannot carry an identity or surfactant axis by construction. It was defined to discriminate Krt8-positive intermediates from activated AT2 cells in single-cell Strunz data at bleomycin days 10 to 15, so averaged over a bulk day-7 immunoprecipitation it estimates state abundance, that is injury severity and composition.
a0_set_demoted.handling_caveat: a heat-shock and immediate-early score is a standard readout of warm ischaemia and handling time, and the deposit records no harvest time, ischaemia time or homogenisation order for any of the 11 mice
a0_set_demoted.contamination_caveat: its members Fn1, Myl9, Vcl and Mcam make it sensitive to mesenchymal contamination of the immunoprecipitation
a0_set_demoted.declared_downgrade_rule: if the A0 covariate separates the arms more strongly than either primary-1 composite does, the primary reading is downgraded to inconclusive, because handling time is unrecorded and confoundable

engagement_control_declared_before_any_v.why_it_exists: A15 gate condition 1 requires a recorded validation that the perturbation took effect, and v1 dropped it. The paired input makes one available.
engagement_control_declared_before_any_v.measured_in: the Whole Lung input libraries of the same 11 mice
engagement_control_declared_before_any_v.provenance: the mouse orthologs of this repository's frozen five-gene fibroblast activation score, the same score behind A2's founding observation
engagement_control_declared_before_any_v.declared_direction_under_3G9: lower, because the published effect of this antibody in the bleomycin model is attenuated collagen (Horan 2008, doi 10.1164/rccm.200706-805OC)
explicitly_not: a fibroblast-compartment readout; the input is a whole-lung homogenate and A15 gate condition 4 refuses it as a compartment measure
an activated-TGF-beta readout; it is a transcript score and A15 gate condition 3 is not satisfied by it
a gate on reading the primary; it is a label on the result
engagement_control_declared_before_any_v.is_reproduction_by_construction: the direction is already published for this antibody, so separation here reproduces a known effect and is not a finding of this repository

purity_and_composition_covariates_from_t.why: every one of the 11 mice has an input aliquot from the same homogenate, which is the standard RiboTag enrichment control, so purity is computable rather than a caveat
purity_and_composition_covariates_from_t.per_mouse_statistic: immunoprecipitation minus input, in log2 CPM, for each marker

macrophage_guard.status: declared in this freeze, not inherited from a frozen source, no decision attached

purity_and_composition_covariates_from_t.declared_downgrade_rule: if the arms differ by 1.0 log2 unit or more in the mean enrichment of any epithelial marker, or in the mean de-enrichment of any non-epithelial marker, the primary reading is downgraded to inconclusive, because a purity gradient alone can move an epithelial score with no state change in any cell
purity_and_composition_covariates_from_t.severity_covariate: the engagement-control score and the A0 covariate, both computed on the input, report per-mouse injury severity

statistic.per_gene_and_per_composite: exact two-sided Wilcoxon rank-sum over all 70 assignments, by complete enumeration
statistic.shift_estimate: Hodges-Lehmann, with an exact distribution-free interval from the 16 pairwise differences and its attained coverage reported rather than assumed
statistic.composite_construction: each member standardised by the pooled within-arm standard deviation across the eight primary mice before averaging, so no member dominates the variance; the unstandardised mean of log2 CPM is reported beside it

multiplicity.per_gene_panel: Benjamini-Hochberg within the panel, reported separately, no decision weight

statistic.no_gate_on_reading_the_primary: every contrast is computed unconditionally by one non-interactive script that emits the whole run record at once, so no human decision sits between any check and the primary
statistic.no_ratio_verdict: the ratio of the primary effect to an injury effect is not used as a decision rule at all
statistic.why_the_ratio_is_refused: its numerator and denominator share the Axum8 bleomycin arm, giving an analytic correlation of -0.463; it had no interval; and conditioning on a gate that only complete separation can pass selects the denominator upward, so the rule declared rival 2 bounded a substantial fraction of the time when the true effect sat on its own rival-stays-live threshold
statistic.injury_contrast_role: reported as context with no decision attached, with its shared-arm correlation of -0.463 recorded so no later session computes an independence-based interval on a ratio
statistic.variance_scale_check: each arm's per-mouse scores, standard deviation and range are written to the run record; if the bleomycin and saline arms' standard deviations differ by more than a factor of 2, the injury contrast is reported as not being a common scale

primary_4_against_4.requires: complete separation of the two arms
primary_4_against_4.minimum_detectable_effect: only complete separation reaches nominal significance, so the smallest detectable shift is the smallest that orders all four treated mice outside all four reference mice

power_quantified_before_any_value_is_rea.a_null_is_compatible_with: a true shift of roughly two to three between-mouse standard deviations, so no null here is evidence of no change

declared_reading.rival_2_stays_live: either primary-1 composite or primary-2 omnibus separates at exact two-sided p at or below 0.028571 in the declared direction, and no purity, macrophage or handling covariate separates. This also demonstrates that the antibody did something, so engagement is established by the change itself.
declared_reading.weak_bound_on_rival_2: the engagement control separates in its declared direction, AND neither primary-1 composite nor primary-2 omnibus separates, AND no covariate separates. Reported as a weak bound, never as absence, and never as evidence about A15.
declared_reading.engagement_not_established: the engagement control does not separate. Then no null bounds anything, the arm is reported as engagement-not-established and design-limited, and that is the result.
declared_reading.inconclusive: every other configuration, including any covariate separation, a disagreement between the two primary-1 composites, a refused composite under the measurability rule, or a variance-scale failure
declared_reading.asymmetry_is_deliberate: a positive result is informative about rival 2; a null is informative only if engagement is separately demonstrated, because a null is exactly what a blockade that did not engage would produce

limits_declared_before_any_value_is_read: Four mice against four, in one experiment, with allocation to antibody not established by the deposit.
The exact test reaches nominal significance only under complete separation, so a null is compatible with a large true shift.

A systemic blocking antibody at day 7 in a mouse lung is not a two-week organoid co-culture of mouse epithelium with human fibroblasts. Anything established here transfers to the organoid system as a plausibility argument, not as a fact.
Antibody blockade is partial and dose-dependent, so this is not a genetic null of the integrin.
The epithelial measurement is ribosome-associated RNA from an anti-HA immunoprecipitation, not total RNA, and the deposit gives no yield, input mass or RNA integrity number.
Epithelial subtype composition can shift under injury, so a programme score cannot separate a state change from a composition change; the paired input constrains this and does not remove it.
No harvest time, warm ischaemia time or homogenisation order is recorded for any mouse, so a stress and chaperone signal cannot be attributed to biology.
The library preparation is a 3-prime tag assay, so all scores are relative within-assay quantities.
The source paper likely reports a 3G9 epithelial contrast, so agreement is reproduction.
No claim row is added and no register grade changes.
prohibitions: no sentence of the form 'the epithelium did not move' or 'the integrin blockade had no epithelial effect' may appear anywhere in the report
no substitution of the endpoint, the arms, the exposures or the batches after any value is read, including after the source paper's results are read
no ratio of the primary effect to an injury effect may carry a verdict
no reading of this result as evidence for or against the A15 hypothesis
no whole-lung score reported as a fibroblast-compartment readout, and no citing of that prohibition to skip the engagement control, which is a whole-lung score used as a pharmacodynamic label
no transcript score called a TGF-beta activation measurement
no claim row, and no re-grading of any existing row
no normal approximation where an exact enumeration is available
no robustness language attached to a leave-one-out table that carries no decision weight
no therapeutic reading in either direction

sensitivities_with_declared_consequences.unstandardised_composite: if its verdict differs from the standardised verdict, the result is inconclusive
sensitivities_with_declared_consequences.euclidean_omnibus_distance: if its verdict differs from the correlation-distance verdict, the omnibus reading is inconclusive
sensitivities_with_declared_consequences.leave_one_mouse_out_over_all_eleven: descriptive, carries no decision weight, and no robustness language may be attached to it
